item.title: IND v SA 2025: “Execution didn't go the way…,” Washington Sundar defends Pant, Jurel’s shot selection in Guwahati Test
item.description: India all-rounder Washington Sundar defended his teammates, Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel, for throwing away their wickets on Day 3 of the second Test against South Africa in Guwahati. item.title: Legendary actor Dharmendra passes away at 89; Indian cricket fraternity shares condolences
item.description: Dharmendra, the legendary Indian film actor, passed away on Monday, November 24, 2025, morning at his Mumbai home following a brief illness. He was 89. Dharmendra died just days before his 90th birthday on December 8, 2025. His last rituals were held at the Pawan Hans crematorium. Dharmendra was brought to Mumbai's Breach Candy Hospital on October 31 after complaining about shortness of breath. item.description: Legendary spinner Anil Kumble on Monday (November 24) highlighted India's unsettled batting line-up in Tests and constant tweaks in the order since the retirements of Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma.
